parameters.signal: results filing; strong = NP YoY > +10 %, NP QoQ > 0, revenue YoY > 0 -> buy put; weak = NP YoY < -10 %, NP QoQ < 0 -> buy call
parameters.expiry: current monthly if >= 2 sessions remain after day 0, else next monthly
parameters.strike_walk: nearest strike to the live price, away from the money, up to 15 strikes; first with two-sided quote, spread <= 10 % of ask, ask >= Rs 2, one lot Rs 600-8,000
parameters.entry: live ask, from 09:15:00, retried every second; waits for the option's first trade today
parameters.exit: from 09:16: bid <= 0.80 x entry sells (stop); bid >= 1.10 x entry turns the trail on, then bid <= 0.98 x highest bid since sells; else first poll from 15:20 at the best bid

parameters.signal: first 1-minute close outside the range from 09:30 to 13:00; trade only when below the low
parameters.option: ATM put (strike nearest the entry minute close, step 50), nearest weekly expiry after today
parameters.entry: last ask of the minute after the signal minute
parameters.stop: bid <= 0.50 x price paid, any second, both days
parameters.exit: best bid at the first quote of the next session's 15:29 minute (from 2026-11-06)

parameters.filters: take the trade only when day-1 opening gap < +0.3 %, range width not in 0.5-0.8 %, India VIX < 17
